plugins.name: three-pillars
plugins.description: Structured TDD pipeline, council deliberation, and session continuity for Claude Code

skills.name: council
skills.description: Convene the Council of High Intelligence — multi-persona deliberation with historical thinkers for deeper analysis of complex problems.
headings: STEP 0: Parse Mode and Select Panel
skills.description_zh: 召集模拟历史思想家组成的多角色讨论小组，对复杂问题开展深入分析。

skills.name: tp-design-audit
skills.description: Design Audit — multi-angle review of a detailed design against the actual codebase before implementation.
skills.description_zh: 在实施前对照实际代码库，从多个角度审查详细设计。

skills.name: tp-design-complete
skills.description: Mark a TDD design as complete — stamp completion, archive handoff.md, archive to three-pillars-docs/completed-tp-designs/, and optionally commit + open a PR merging the design branch back to the base branch.
skills.description_zh: 标记 TDD 流水线设计完成，写入完成标记、归档 handoff.md 和设计至 three-pillars-docs/completed-tp-designs/，可追加提交并创建将设计分支合回基分支的 PR。

skills.name: tp-design-detail
skills.description: Produce a detailed-design.md from an existing design.md. Maps high-level entities and behaviors to concrete modules, interfaces, and test boundaries.
skills.description_zh: 从已有 design.md 生成 detailed-design.md，将高层实体及行为映射到具体模块、接口和测试边界。

skills.name: tp-design-learn
skills.description: Synthesize a completed design's impact into project docs updates and identify affected sibling designs. The "close the loop" step after implementation-audit.
skills.description_zh: 在实现审计后总结已完成设计的影响，提出项目文档更新并识别受影响的相邻设计，完成设计反馈闭环。

skills.name: tp-design-release
skills.description: Release your lock on a design without completing it. Use when you're stepping away and want a teammate to pick it up cleanly, without them having to --force-takeover.
skills.description_zh: 释放设计锁而不标记设计完成，让其他成员继续接手且无需强制接管。

skills.name: tp-design
skills.description: Interactive high-level design conversation that produces a design.md artifact in three-pillars-docs/tp-designs/{name}/. First step in the TDD pipeline.
skills.description_zh: 通过交互式高层设计讨论生成 three-pillars-docs/tp-designs/{name}/design.md，作为该 TDD 流水线首步。

skills.name: tp-docs-init
skills.description: Scaffold architecture.md, product_roadmap.md, and known_issues.md in three-pillars-docs/ from codebase analysis. Creates the three project docs that the TDD pipeline reads for context. Assumes three-pillars-docs/vision.md already exists — if missing, recommends /tp-setup first.
skills.description_zh: 分析代码库并在 three-pillars-docs/ 初始化 architecture.md、product_roadmap.md、known_issues.md，供 TDD 流程读取。要求已有 vision.md，缺失时建议先执行 /tp-setup。

skills.name: tp-docs-update
skills.description: Targeted update to vision.md, architecture.md, product_roadmap.md, and/or known_issues.md after a milestone. Shows diff-style proposals for user approval.
skills.description_zh: 在里程碑后定向更新 vision.md、architecture.md、product_roadmap.md 或 known_issues.md，以差异形式展示建议供用户批准。

skills.name: tp-guide
skills.description: Read project docs and propose what to do next. Surfaces highest-impact work from roadmap, known issues, and in-flight designs.
skills.description_zh: 阅读项目文档，根据路线图、已知问题和进行中设计提出下一项高影响工作建议。

skills.name: tp-implementation-audit
skills.description: Final audit of a completed plan — verify the full implementation against both design.md and detailed-design.md.
skills.description_zh: 对已完成计划开展最终审计，依据 design.md 和 detailed-design.md 核验完整实现。

skills.name: tp-inflight
skills.description: Print the in-flight design registry — every origin/tp/* design branch with its owner, phase, branch, age, and staleness — built live from the remote. Read-only, fail-open, no lock, no side effects. Use to see what other designs are in flight before you start work.
skills.description_zh: 从远端实时生成进行中设计登记表，列出所有 origin/tp/* 分支的负责人、阶段、分支、存续时间及过时情况。只读、无锁和副作用，适用于开始工作前了解其他设计。

skills.name: tp-merge-from-main
skills.description: Sync a base branch INTO a design's worktree (base-sync) and auto-resolve the safe living-doc conflict classes behind a zero-drop verifier, deferring everything semantic to the human. Re-runs tests, re-pushes only when green, updates the PR. This is the reversible base-into-branch operation — landing the PR is the separate /tp-merge land gate.
headings: tp-merge-from-main — worktree-aware base-sync + living-doc conflict resolution
skills.description_zh: 将基分支同步进设计工作树，在零丢失验证器保护下自动解决安全的持续更新文档冲突，并将语义冲突交由人工。重新测试后仅在通过时推送并更新 PR；正式合并由 /tp-merge 单独处理。

skills.name: tp-merge
skills.description: Land a reviewed PR at the irreversible boundary: enforce the deterministic merge gate (require_merge_gate_pass — seven predicates incl. a current human approval, a fresh ci-local stamp, and a head-bound review-proof comment) and run the irreversible gh pr merge ONLY on PASS. Refuse on a blocked gate, printing the blocking predicate(s) and how to authorize. The base-into-branch base-sync operation is the separate /tp-merge-from-main skill.
headings: tp-merge — the land gate (irreversible `gh pr merge`)
Serial landings and the depth-1 revert window
skills.description_zh: 在正式合并前执行确定性门槛，检查当前人工批准、最新本地 CI 标记、绑定当前提交的审查证据等七项条件，仅通过后运行 gh pr merge；受阻时列出条件及授权方式。基分支同步另用 /tp-merge-from-main。

skills.name: tp-migrate
skills.description: Migrate a three-pillars repo from the legacy docs/tdd-* layout to the current three-pillars-docs/tp-* layout. Wraps skills/_shared/migrate.py.
skills.description_zh: 将 Three Pillars 仓库从旧 docs/tdd-* 布局迁移到 three-pillars-docs/tp-*，封装 skills/_shared/migrate.py。

skills.name: tp-phase-implement
skills.description: Execute a phase from plan.md by running red-green-refactor cycles for each task. Spawns subagents for independent tasks within a phase.
skills.description_zh: 执行 plan.md 中一个阶段，为每项任务运行失败测试—通过测试—重构循环，并用子代理处理该阶段的独立任务。

skills.name: tp-phase-review
skills.description: Review what was built against the plan and design. Flags gaps, regressions, and deviations. Writes review.md.
skills.description_zh: 对照计划和设计审查已构建内容，标记缺口、回归和偏差并写入 review.md。

skills.name: tp-plan-audit
skills.description: Plan Audit — verify plan.md is consistent with design.md and detailed-design.md. Runs deterministic scripts then convenes an engineering council for judgment calls.
skills.description_zh: 核验 plan.md 与 design.md、detailed-design.md 的一致性，先运行确定性脚本，再组织工程讨论处理需判断的问题。

skills.name: tp-plan
skills.description: Generate a plan.md from detailed-design.md — a sequenced list of implementation tasks, each with test criteria, ready for /tp-phase-implement.
skills.description_zh: 根据 detailed-design.md 生成 plan.md，将实现任务按顺序排列并附测试标准，供 /tp-phase-implement 执行。

skills.name: tp-post-merge
skills.description: Post-merge teardown for a completed design. Verifies the completion PR is merged, then removes the design branch, sibling worktree, and MRU entry. The post-merge mirror of /tp-design-complete — the sole merge-verified lifecycle teardown path.
skills.description_zh: 在确认完成 PR 已合并后清理设计分支、关联工作树及最近使用条目，作为设计完成后的合并验证清理流程。

skills.name: tp-pr-fix
skills.description: One-shot PR-fix worker — classify review comments, gate by reviewer identity, generate ONE structural-fix commit per round, push, and label. Composes into the `tp-pr-iterate` loop or runs standalone.
skills.description_zh: 按审查者身份门槛处理 PR 评论并分类，每轮生成一个结构修复提交、推送并添加标签，可独立运行或接入 tp-pr-iterate。

skills.name: tp-pr-iterate
skills.description: Autonomous PR-iteration loop driver — poll review comments, classify (heuristic + Sonnet), defer conflicting structural fixes, dispatch to `tp-pr-fix` per round, reply-and-resolve every thread, apply caps + guards, and terminate only at two-stable: both review sources quiet AND zero unresolved actionable threads verified against GitHub. Classifier-flip is necessary but not sufficient.
skills.description_zh: 驱动自主 PR 迭代，轮询并分类评论、暂缓冲突的结构修复、逐轮调用 tp-pr-fix、回复解决讨论并应用次数及安全限制。仅在两类审查来源均无新意见且 GitHub 上无未解决可行动讨论时结束。

skills.name: tp-promote
skills.description: Promote a seed (seed.md) to a committed, floor-clearing design.md on the tp/<slug> branch, ready for a design-ready fleet pass. Reads the seed's Open questions, derives a single batched confirm block, collects one operator answer, drafts design.md, validates the floor, and hands off to /tp-run-full-design <slug> --skip-design (Mode B).
skills.description_zh: 将 seed.md 初稿推进为 tp/<slug> 分支上已提交且满足最低标准的 design.md，汇总开放问题为一次确认、收集用户回答、起草校验后交给跳过初始设计的全流程。

skills.name: tp-revert
skills.description: Revert a design landing: probe depth/forecast, apply git revert -m 1, carve out living docs, regenerate amendments, and land as a single-commit PR through the standard gate.
headings: 1. Unstage ALL doc-tree changes (including re-added in-flight files like
2. Restore tracked doc files to HEAD — living docs are never textually unwound;
the archive is kept so cites remain live and the amendment has a home
3. Delete resurrected now-untracked in-flight files — the lock is NOT resurrected;
Resolve the FREE chokepoint git-toplevel-first (see first-run.md §Resolve a FREE _shared script)
skills.description_zh: 撤销已合入的设计，先检查回退深度和影响预测，再执行 git revert -m 1，单独处理持续更新文档、重建设计修订，并通过标准门槛提交单次提交的 PR。

skills.name: tp-run-full-design
skills.description: Autonomous full-design orchestrator. Drives the TDD pipeline unattended for a single task — pickup → design → worker → audits → PR — and produces a decision log for human review.
headings: tp-run-full-design — Autonomous Orchestrator (Mode A0, single candidate)
skills.description_zh: 为单项任务自主编排完整设计流程，从接手、设计、实施到审计和 PR，并产出供人工审查的决策日志。

skills.name: tp-session-clear
skills.description: Clear the handoff.md from a design's directory when switching to a completely different task. Prevents stale context from contaminating the next session.
skills.description_zh: 切换到完全不同任务时清除设计目录中的 handoff.md，避免旧上下文影响下一会话。

skills.name: tp-session-restore
skills.description: Restore session context from handoff.md in the design's directory at the start of a new conversation. Gives you continuity without re-explaining.
skills.description_zh: 在新对话开始时，从设计目录 handoff.md 恢复会话上下文以衔接工作。

skills.name: tp-session-save
skills.description: Save structured session context to handoff.md in the design's directory for continuity across conversations. Use at end of a session or before switching phases.
skills.description_zh: 将结构化会话上下文保存到设计目录 handoff.md，适用于会话结束或阶段切换前。

skills.name: tp-setup
skills.description: Conversational project setup. Draws out the project's 'why' into three-pillars-docs/vision.md — the first artifact every other TDD skill reads. Run this first on any new project.
skills.description_zh: 通过对话明确项目目的，生成 three-pillars-docs/vision.md 作为其他设计流程技能的首个上下文产物，适用于新项目设置。

skills.name: tp-spec
skills.description: Manage living spec deltas — scaffold, validate, and merge spec-delta.md files into domain base specs.
skills.description_zh: 管理持续更新的规格增量，创建、校验并将 spec-delta.md 合入领域基础规格。

skills.name: tp-spike-auto
skills.description: Autonomous spike pipeline — interactive design, then hands-off plan/audit/implement/results with a decision log for morning review.
headings: Step 5.5: Closeout — propagate learnings (enforced, no longer deferred)
skills.description_zh: 先交互制定限时技术探索设计，再自主执行计划、审计、实施和结果总结，生成供后续人工审查的决策日志。

skills.name: tp-spike-implement
skills.description: Execute a spike from plan.md — serial exploration with human review gates at phase boundaries. Speed over ceremony.
skills.description_zh: 根据 plan.md 串行执行技术探索实验，在阶段边界设置人工审查门槛，采用轻量流程推进。

skills.name: tp-spike-learn
skills.description: Synthesize spike learnings into project docs updates and identify affected downstream designs. The "close the loop" step after spike-results.
skills.description_zh: 在探索结果完成后，总结发现并更新项目文档，识别受影响的后续设计。

skills.name: tp-spike-plan
skills.description: Generate an experiment plan.md from a spike-flavored design.md — phases of hypothesis-driven tasks for exploratory work.
skills.description_zh: 根据技术探索 design.md 生成实验 plan.md，以假设驱动任务组织阶段。

skills.name: tp-spike-results
skills.description: Capture spike findings and verdict into spike-results.md. Produces a structured record of what was learned, what demos were created, and what architecture decisions emerged.
skills.description_zh: 将技术探索发现和判定写入 spike-results.md，结构化记录学到的内容、演示成果及架构决策。

skills.name: tp-spike
skills.description: Interactive spike design conversation that produces a spike-flavored design.md for time-boxed experiments. Optionally links back to a parent design.
skills.description_zh: 通过交互讨论形成限时实验的技术探索 design.md，可关联上级设计。

skills.name: tp-task-cycle
skills.description: Execute a single red-green-refactor TDD cycle. Human-invokable standalone, and also the kernel embedded by /tp-phase-implement for automated execution.
skills.description_zh: 执行单次失败测试—通过测试—重构的 TDD 循环，可人工独立调用，也作为 /tp-phase-implement 自动执行的核心。

skills.name: tp-test-setup
skills.description: Configure test infrastructure for the TDD pipeline, informed by the project's stated architecture. Runs after /tp-docs-init so test-runner and layout choices are grounded in the documented system structure.
skills.description_zh: 根据已记录的项目架构配置 TDD 测试基础设施，在 /tp-docs-init 后选择测试运行器和布局。

headings: Review decisions.md the next morning, then:
Close the conversation, switch machines, come back later:
